description: A small, white wooden stool with a rainbow-colored top. The stool has a sturdy, boxy design with crisscrossing supports. The top surface is made of individual planks painted in the colors of the rainbow: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple. The wood grain is visible on the white parts, giving it a slightly rustic look. This stool appears to be a decorative piece, possibly for a garden, patio, or as an accent piece indoors. Its compact size makes it versatile for various settings.
